rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something that causes no harm or danger.

example.english: This cleaning product is harmless even for children.
example.traditional: 呢種清潔劑對小朋友都冇害。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 dou1 mou5 hoi6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that a person, remark, or joke is not intended to hurt anyone.

example.english: My joke just now was harmless, so please don't be upset.
example.traditional: 我頭先嗰句笑話冇惡意，你唔好嬲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 go2 geoi3 siu3 waa2 mou5 ok3 ji3 nei5 m4 hou2 niu5

rows.note: Use this for an act or joke that is inoffensive and causes no serious damage, rather than specifically describing the speaker's intent.

example.english: This minor mistake is harmless and will not affect the overall plan.
example.traditional: 呢個小小失誤無傷大雅，唔會影響整個計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu2 siu2 sat1 ng6 mou4 soeng1 daai6 ngaa5 m4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 zing2 go3 gai3 waak6
